title: AdenoBuilder: modular assembly of recombinant adenovirus genomes from high-copy plasmids
author: Jessica J. Miciak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qt5dwq6
materials: Assessement of viral titer by immunofluorescence

steps.title: Prepare DNA mixture
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 125 fmol of each of the seven AdenoBuilder plasmids into a 1.5 ml tube (using the mol/g conversion table); ensure the combined plasmid volume does not exceed 20 µl.

steps.title: Add water and restriction enzymes
steps.instruction: Add water to bring the DNA mixture volume to 20.5 µl, then add 2.5 µl 10X restriction enzyme buffer (manufacturer’s) and 2 µl BstBI (40 U). Vortex, briefly centrifuge, and incubate at 50 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Isothermal assembly
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl 2X HiFi NEBuilder Master Mix, mix by pipetting, return the tube to 50 °C and incubate for an additional 1 h.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl TE buffer, extract the reaction with 100 µl buffered phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol, and transfer the aqueous upper layer to a fresh 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: DNA precipitation and resuspension
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl 7.5 M ammonium acetate and 250 µl ethanol, vortex briefly, centrifuge >15 000 g for 5 min, wash the pellet with 70 % ethanol, air‑dry, then either store at –20 °C or dissolve in 10 µl water for ≥15 min.

steps.title: Verify assembly by agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve the final pellet in 20 µl 1X gel‑loading dye and run on a 0.8 % agarose gel at 200 V·h; a ladder up to the full Ad5 genome size (≈36 kb) should be visible.

steps.title: Seed HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293 cells in standard culture flasks 24–48 h before electroporation; grow in DMEM + 6 % FBS + 1X penicillin/streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Detach cells
steps.instruction: On the day of electroporation, detach cells with trypsin‑EDTA and add an equal volume of warm medium to the suspension.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Transfer ~2.0 × 10⁶ cells to a sterile 15 ml conical tube and pellet at 90 g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet once with PBS, re‑pellet as above, and carefully remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Pre‑warm culture flask
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm a T25 flask containing 4 ml HEK293 medium.

steps.title: Add complement plasmid (optional)
steps.instruction: If the recombinant virus contains deletions or mutations outside E1, add 1 µg uncut pAd5‑B7 plasmid directly to the DNA sample before electroporation.

steps.title: Mix DNA with Nucleofector solution
steps.instruction: In the biosafety hood, add 90 µl freshly supplemented Nucleofector Solution SF to the 10 µl assembled DNA (including any added complement plasmid) and mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Combine DNA‑cell mixture
steps.instruction: Add the DNA‑SF mixture to the cell pellet, resuspend cells by gentle pipetting, and transfer 100 µl of the suspension to a Nanocuvette supplied with the SF kit.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Load the cuvette into a 4D Nucleofector and run program CM130.

steps.title: Transfer cells to medium
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the electroporated cells to the pre‑warmed T25 flask with 4 ml medium using the supplied transfer pipet, then return the flask to the incubator.

steps.title: Harvest viral lysate
steps.instruction: Begin observation on day 3 post‑electroporation; at 3–5 days, when cells detach and medium turns yellow, scrape cells and media together and freeze in a dry‑ice/ethanol bath (or replace medium with 0.5 ml PBS before harvest for a more concentrated stock).

steps.title: Freeze‑thaw cycles
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen lysate in a 37 °C water bath, vortex for 15 s, then repeat the freeze‑thaw‑vortex cycle two more times.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 9 000 g for 10 min at 4 °C to clarify.

steps.title: Store viral stock
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified supernatant to aliquots and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Seed cells for titration
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293 cells in a 24‑well plate at 1.0 × 10⁴ cells per well.

steps.title: Infect cells with lysate
steps.instruction: When cells reach 70–90 % confluence, infect with viral lysate; for primary lysates test volumes of 0, 1, 5, 25, and 125 µl (amplified stocks should be serially diluted).

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize
steps.instruction: At 24 h post‑infection, wash monolayers once with PBS, then fix/permeabilize in PBS containing 4 % paraformaldehyde and 0.1 % Triton‑X100 for 30 min at room temperature; wash twice with PBS.

steps.title: Add FITC‑hexon antibody
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl per well of FITC‑conjugated anti‑Ad5 hexon antibody diluted 1:100 in PBS with 2 % BSA; incubate at room temperature for 1 h.

steps.title: Wash antibody
steps.instruction: Remove the antibody solution and wash the wells once with PBS.

steps.title: Visualize and quantify
steps.instruction: Visualize infected cells under fluorescence microscopy; count wells containing 10–100 foci to calculate infectious units per milliliter of viral stock.
